name: Igneus
source:
The Lake Kingdom, the center where all races gather after the war, you, a newcomer to the city, find yourself studying at the academy.

With the advancement of technology made by artificers and mages, remote communication devices have become more common and with them come apps, such as navigation, inventory, skill tree and.... hooking up.

Igneus is a recently launched app to make it easier for men to have fun. Come and have some fun on this lonely night.

[From [url=https://kreig.itch.io/igneus]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
湖之王国是战后各族汇聚的中心之地；而初来乍到的你，此刻正在城中的学院求学。

随着工匠与法师们不断推动技术革新，远程通讯设备日益普及，各类应用程序也应运而生——诸如导航、物品栏、技能树，还有…约炮。

“Igneus”是一款新近上线、专为方便男人们寻欢作乐而打造的应用程序。在这个寂寞的夜晚，快来尽情享受一番吧。

[摘自[url=https://kreig.itch.io/igneus]itch.io[/url]]
